notes.title: Welcome
notes.notes:
We made it!We are very happy to be here with you on steam thanks to your support we made it!

We would like to identify some problems:

The release date may change due to changes we made on steam it may take an extra from 2-10 days for the release to happen we are very sorry for this!

That's it the game will be released in the next days we would like to inform you that we have fixed all the bugs and glitches we found so far.
